models_evaluated: Aleph palliative care CDSS machine learning predictive models

links.outcome: Whether usability testing with potential users identified workflow implementation issues
links.effect: Think-aloud and UX assessment identified most workflow implementation issues; SUS 62.7±14.1 and 65±26.2 in two rounds; UEQ-S 1.42 and 1.5.
links.quote: The think-aloud method and including the UX dimension helped us to identify most of the workflow implementation issues.

screen.reason: Empirical study evaluating clinician usability and user experience of a predictive clinical decision support system for palliative care using simulated evaluation sessions.
